about: Stage 1.6 check questions per shot, written 2026-10-27 05:45 from eval/LABEL_GUIDE.md and the third-pass rules R1-R8 (eval/labels/adjudication_rules.json), before any test-3 footage was seen. In the product these are drafted from the shot text and confirmed by the person, like query_en. 'parts' are extra conditions; a frame passes when every part and the main question pass (the frame score is the minimum).

SH-01.main: Is the outside of a café or coffee shop visible from the street, such as its storefront, sign, façade or café tables set out on the pavement?

SH-02.main: Is this a view of the inside of a café or coffee shop, with tables or chairs visible?

SH-03.main: Is this a close-up in which coffee beans fill a large part of the image?

SH-04.main: Is ground coffee coming out of a coffee grinder?

SH-05.main: Is coffee or milk being poured or dripping into a cup or glass?

SH-06.main: Is a cup or glass of coffee the main subject, standing on a table, saucer or counter, with nothing being poured into it?

SH-07.main: Is a person drinking from a coffee cup or holding a coffee cup up to drink?

SH-08.main: Are at least two people visible?
parts: Is this the inside of a café or coffee shop?

SH-09.main: Is coffee flowing out of the portafilter of an espresso machine?

SH-10.main: Is a bag, box or other package of coffee visible?

SH-11.main: Is a person preparing coffee, for example grinding, tamping, operating a coffee machine or pouring?
parts: Is this a café, bar, restaurant or other commercial setting?
